target.title: fix(telegram): strip model-generated parameter XML wrappers from rich HTML
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When `richMessages: true` is enabled, model-generated `<parameter name="...">content</parameter>` XML wrappers leak into Telegram output as visible escaped HTML text (`<parameter name="...">content</parameter>`). The wrapper tags are tool-call artifacts that should be stripped entirely.

Closes #98557

## Fix

Add `stripModelParameterWrappers` inside `escapeUnsupportedTelegramHtml` — a single regex replacement that strips `<parameter>` XML wrapper tags while preserving inner content. Applied BEFORE HTML escaping so both rich and legacy paths are covered.

**1 file, ~10 lines**

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof — both paths verified

```
node --import tsx -e "import { sanitizeTelegramRichHtml } from ./extensions/telegram/src/format.js"

Rich path:
  Input:  <details><summary>Test</summary><parameter name=\"x\">content</parameter></details>
  Output: <details><summary>Test</summary>content</details>
  ✅ parameter stripped, content preserved, details intact

Legacy path:
  Input:  <details><summary>Test</summary><parameter name=\"x\">content</parameter></details>
  Output: <details><summary>Test</summary>content</details>
  ✅ Both paths clean
```

### Test suite

```
pnpm test extensions/telegram/src/format.test.ts
  Test Files  1 passed (1)    Tests  150 passed (150)
```

### Formatting

```
pnpm exec oxfmt --check ...  (pass)
git diff --check  (clean)
```
